texts.label: text
texts.orig: Lockout the pump before working on it!
texts.text: Lockout the pump before working on it!

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Most mechanical rigs are equipped with a safety control valve for the pump located at the pump drive. Before working on the pump, be sure this valve as well as the pump control valve on the driller's console are in the closed position. If a rig does not have the safety valve, remove the air supply hose from rotor seal of the pump drive clutch. By doing this, the pump cannot be engaged while you are working on it. Electric rigs have electric controls in the SCR house and driller's control station that should be locked out and tagged.
texts.text: Most mechanical rigs are equipped with a safety control valve for the pump located at the pump drive. Before working on the pump, be sure this valve as well as the pump control valve on the driller's console are in the closed position. If a rig does not have the safety valve, remove the air supply hose from rotor seal of the pump drive clutch. By doing this, the pump cannot be engaged while you are working on it. Electric rigs have electric controls in the SCR house and driller's control station that should be locked out and tagged.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Do not tighten leaking unions, valve covers or cylinder head covers while pump is running with pressure.
texts.text: Do not tighten leaking unions, valve covers or cylinder head covers while pump is running with pressure.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Before removing the nail from the shear relief valve, release pressure by opening a valve on the discharge line as close to the pump as possible.
texts.text: Before removing the nail from the shear relief valve, release pressure by opening a valve on the discharge line as close to the pump as possible.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Be sure that the shear relief valve is set to release at a pressure not exceeding working pressure of the pump, valves and mud lines. Do not use allen wrenches, ice picks or other rods made of high carbon steel to replace nails in shear relief valves.
texts.text: Be sure that the shear relief valve is set to release at a pressure not exceeding working pressure of the pump, valves and mud lines. Do not use allen wrenches, ice picks or other rods made of high carbon steel to replace nails in shear relief valves.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Use only what the manufacturer recommends!
texts.text: Use only what the manufacturer recommends!

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Keep the shear relief valve safety cover in its proper closed position at all times. When the relief valve pin is sheared due to excessive pump pressure, the sheared ends can fly some distance and cause injury to workers.
texts.text: Keep the shear relief valve safety cover in its proper closed position at all times. When the relief valve pin is sheared due to excessive pump pressure, the sheared ends can fly some distance and cause injury to workers.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: There are some parts of a pump that are too heavy for one man to handle, such as liners and cylinder head covers. Assistance is necessary in handling these items to avoid back injuries and possible mashed fingers or hands. Use hoists or other means to lift heavy parts.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Never remove or install belts on rod oiler or piston sprayer pumps while pump is engaged.
texts.text: Never remove or install belts on rod oiler or piston sprayer pumps while pump is engaged.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Extreme care is necessary when using sledge hammers and hammer wrenches on or around pumps.
texts.text: Extreme care is necessary when using sledge hammers and hammer wrenches on or around pumps.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The working area on and around mud pumps should be kept as clean and dry as possible.
texts.text: The working area on and around mud pumps should be kept as clean and dry as possible.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Never attempt to work on a mud pump while the mud pump is in operation.
texts.text: Never attempt to work on a mud pump while the mud pump is in operation.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Mud pump strokes should not be counted by hand.
texts.text: Mud pump strokes should not be counted by hand.
